title: The Magic Key — LIGHTHOUSE: PSYCOHOLIC + UNCHAINED + LIGHT WAVELENGTH

physics.note: These equations describe the physical light coordinate only. They do not assign psychological meaning to a wavelength.

epistemic_boundary: A screenshot RGB color does not determine one unique physical wavelength without display spectral characterization.

topa_spider_prior_art.usable_signal: Existing registry model treats wavelength as a physically measurable signal coordinate/opcode analogy while retaining physical noise and receiver dependence.
topa_spider_prior_art.guard: Analogy is not a theorem that arbitrary wavelength carries symbolic meaning.

topa_spider_prior_art.usable_signal: A wavelength/frequency-equivalent manifold can be mathematically valid while remaining non-specific for target identity.

steps.detail: Kept welfare authority W_t separate from memory state M_t and cue C_t.
Projected PSYCOHOLIC as GOAL/CONSENT/EXIT constraints and UNCHAINED as CUE/MEMORY/PROVENANCE/PRESENT_ANCHOR graph.
Both parents preserve human authority, provenance, uncertainty and explicit exit; no rule requires memory retrieval to define welfare.
Added lambda only as a measurable cue/address dimension, not as a psychological command or truth source.
SPECTRAL_MEMORY_MAGIC_KEY = compact cue constraints plus optional measured lambda/band when a real optical sensor supplies it.
No claim that wavelength alone uniquely identifies a memory or welfare state; semantic collision test requires a frozen multimodal cue corpus.
Across representative visible wavelengths, the certified semantic route remains invariant because no empirical lambda-to-memory/welfare law has been supplied.

components.lambda: Optional measured light wavelength or spectral band as an additional physical cue coordinate.
components.Source: Origin of cue and spectral measurement.
components.Uncertainty: Separate uncertainty for cultural identity, personal memory, wavelength measurement and predicted welfare effect.
components.PresentAnchor: Explicit route back to present context.

machine_function.name: JANUS_LIGHTHOUSE_SPECTRAL_MEMORY_WELFARE_ASSIST
machine_function.purpose: Use a physically grounded multimodal cue to retrieve an associated memory region, then allow that memory to inform—but never define—the human's currently chosen welfare goal.
machine_function.canonical_definition: LIGHTHOUSE(K_t,C_t,M_t,W_t,lambda) := RESOLVE_CUE(C_t,lambda) -> RETRIEVE_MEMORY(M_t) -> LABEL_PROVENANCE_AND_UNCERTAINTY -> PRESENT_TO_HUMAN -> IF W_t explicitly selects/accepts relevance THEN ASSIST_HAPPINESS(K_t,W_t,o) ELSE RETURN_PRESENT
machine_function.important_non_implication: RETRIEVED_MEMORY does not become a welfare objective automatically.

spectral_magic_key.candidate_definition: K_spectral = minimal cue subset from {AudioID,VisualFeatures,Context,lambda_band,TemporalHints} that uniquely retrieves a target memory cluster within a frozen candidate universe.
spectral_magic_key.novel_testable_question: Does adding a measured spectral coordinate reduce multimodal cue collisions enough to justify its sensing/verification cost?
spectral_magic_key.cost_law: Any gain in discriminative power must be charged against spectral sensing, calibration, storage, retrieval and verification cost under NO_FREE_SEMANTIC_COMPRESSION.

main_result.name: LIGHTHOUSE_RESULT
main_result.compressed_formula: LIGHT -> CUE -> MEMORY -> HUMAN_SELECTION -> WELFARE_ASSIST -> PRESENT
main_result.interpretation_ru: Получилась не «длина волны счастья», а спектрально привязанный Магический Ключ: свет может дать дополнительную физически измеримую координату для адресации памяти, память может вернуть контекст, а право определить желаемое состояние остаётся у человека.
architectural_gain: Adds a physically measurable orthogonal coordinate to a multimodal Magic Key.
Separates retrieval power from welfare authority.
Creates a direct hardware path for future optical/sensor experiments without granting wavelength mystical semantics.
Provides a collision-reduction hypothesis that can be falsified on a frozen cue corpus.

next_gate.preregistration: Freeze a corpus of multimodal cues, use real measured spectral inputs or calibrated synthetic wavelength labels, compare collision rate with and without lambda, and separately charge sensing/calibration/retrieval/verification cost.
next_gate.success_condition: lambda materially reduces false retrieval collisions without creating hidden cost or being promoted to welfare authority.
next_gate.failure_condition: no collision reduction, unstable sensor dependence, or semantic overreach from wavelength to meaning.

provenance.scientific_boundary: Architecture hypothesis and preregistered experiment design only. No claim of a universal wavelength for happiness, memory, consciousness, or cognition.
